limitations: Each case occupies two adjacent columns (pre-treatment, post-treatment); the Case 1 / Case 2 / Case 3 header row and the colspan of the age row group the six value columns.
The draft tool reads the Case 1-3 header line as the column time header; time labels are taken by hand from the b00011 row (Pre-treatment, Ato-Oxy 28 days, Pretreatment, Ato-Oxy Night PSG).
Case 3 post-treatment column is a single-night study after one dose, not a 28-day value; no offset is recorded for it.
